translationRepairs: He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Rende of the Xiao clan.
He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Renyi of the Xiao clan.
母曰仁懿皇后蕭氏 uses 懿 (yì), not 德; idiomatic Rende is a wrong romanization, and Renyi restores the posthumous title without other changes.
He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Rende of the Xiao clan.
He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Renyi of the Xiao clan.
Literal likewise misreads 仁懿 as Rende; Renyi matches 懿 and keeps the rest of the sentence intact.
On renchen day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
On renchen day the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.

以皇太弟重元為皇太叔 names Chongyuan by the prior title 皇太弟 while appointing him 皇太叔; “the Emperor's younger brother” wrongly makes him Daozong's brother, whereas capitalized Imperial Younger Brother treats 皇太弟 as the title.
On renchen day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
On renchen day the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
Literal has the same kinship error for 皇太弟; rendering it as the title Imperial Younger Brother correctly pairs with the promotion to 皇太叔.

On chou day of the sixth month Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

On yichou day of the sixth month Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
六月乙丑 is the sexagenary day yichou; idiomatic “chou day” drops the heavenly stem 乙, and yichou restores the full date label.

On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital and seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher was ordered; on guimao day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.

On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital and seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher was ordered; on guiwei day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.
癸未 is guiwei; guimao would be 癸卯. The repair corrects the branch without changing the appointment wording.

On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital; ordered seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher; on guimao day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.

On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital; ordered seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher; on guiwei day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.
Literal likewise reads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is the correct romanization of 未 versus 卯.
